headline: On October 18, 1963: Félicette, the first cat in space
captionCards: Félicette had electrodes implanted to monitor her brain in space
Her mission provided key data on space travel's impact on life
instagramCaption:
Félicette, a Parisian stray, became the first cat in space. \\[Blank Line]\\[On October 18, 1963, Félicette was launched into space as part of the French space program. She was one of 14 female cats trained for the mission, with electrodes implanted to monitor her neurological activity. The capsule was recovered 13 minutes after launch, and Félicette survived, though she was euthanised two months later for brain examination. This mission provided valuable data on the effects of space travel on living beings. \\[Blank Line]\\[What do you think about using animals in space research? \\[Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳]
